title: Touch the Sky / YUGO Game — seam, shear, flip and Return

declared_roles.field: structured play field / pins / declared cut rule
declared_roles.carrier: ball, four-digit word or typed record
declared_roles.plus_one: one binding event at the white center seam; not arithmetic n+1
declared_roles.iota: fixed event or pivot in the existing YUGO source
declared_roles.yugo: rotatable normalized local direction in the existing YUGO source
declared_roles.center_seam: white event line; not the zipper by itself
declared_roles.zipper: paired toothed boundary in the existing YUGO source
declared_roles.shear: split full carrier into left hidden, visible middle cut and right hidden
declared_roles.return: restore HOME view while preserving the ledger
declared_roles.restart: begin a new round from the returned carrier without deleting prior records

invariants: PLUS_ONE increments the event counter exactly once per round
left + visible + right reconstruct the eight-digit square
FLIP swaps A and B and applying the orientation map twice restores the label
RETURN changes the active view but does not append to or clear the ledger
RESTART preserves the returned carrier and ledger
Lissajous may display phase relations but is not the stored state
claim_boundary: This fixture formalizes one deterministic local replay and its controls. It does not identify Middle Square, the YUGO ball game, UDF, Scarab, Lissajous, Ulam, Ghostgrid, CRT or QRT as one mechanism.
